name: comsol-mcp
description: Repo-local Codex plugin for driving a local COMSOL session.

interface.shortDescription: Control a local COMSOL session from Codex
interface.longDescription: Starts a local COMSOL server, opens models, edits parameters, runs studies, exports plots, launches a visible COMSOL Desktop client, and mirrors the native GUI into a browser workspace.
defaultPrompt: Open my COMSOL model and run a study.
Set a COMSOL parameter and export a result plot.
Start a visible COMSOL Desktop client for this session.
